rules.note: Throne of New Tunaria - the Overseer never dies; this say line is the scripted end. Verified in live Wuoshi logs (Jun-Jul 2026), spoken twice per win.

rules.phrase: They are just too powerful, my lord! My only hope rests with you, my love, Mayong.

rules.note: The Queen's earlier surrender line (~14s before the final one) - a second marker in case the encounter idles out between the two.
